facts.fact: The government allocated N$145 million over three years as seed funding for the Universal Service Fund, announced by the Minister of ICT at the launch.
At the Fund's launch the minister announced the state seed funding, and CRAN had already disbursed a N$31 million subsidy to MTC for nine network sites.

note: Figure is N$145m here against N$115m in CRAN's reports; each recorded as stated. The MTC subsidy is a payment out of the Fund, recorded under acted.
